Considering heart surgery abroad? Explore a comprehensive CABG package in Riyadh.

The package covers a Triple Vessel CABG surgery at King Faisal Specialist Hospital & Research Centre.
Hospital stay ranges from 6 to 9 days, with 1‑3 days in the ICU and inpatient physiotherapy.
Included services: multidisciplinary evaluation, virtual consultation, surgery, medications, and one post‑discharge follow‑up.

Read the full guide:
https://www.placidway.com/package/8457/CABG-Triple-Vessel-Bypass-Open-Heart
